title: The 5 Product Levels Explained Simply | Marketing Management Ep 16
description:
A new home kitchen near Mrs. Rao starts selling millet laddoos at the same price, yet she stays with Laddoo Lab. Why? Because she is buying much more than a laddoo. In this animated lesson Zoya draws the six-pack as rings, like an onion, to explain product levels and the product hierarchy.

You will see Philip Kotler's five product levels and Theodore Levitt's big idea that firms compete less on what they make and more on what they add around it. Then we build the six-pack live, ring by ring: the core benefit (a healthy treat her daughter enjoys), the basic product, the expected product, the augmented product (Monday delivery, a photo message and a card from Nani) and the potential product, and see where Laddoo Lab beats its new rival. We zoom out through Kotler's product hierarchy, from a need family down to one exact item, see product levels at work today in a hotel and a phone maker, and end honestly: extras cost money, and today's extra becomes tomorrow's expectation.

This is Episode 16 of our Marketing Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
